name: Disaar Beauty Skincare Oil Free SPF PA+++ 50+ Sunscreen Instant Protection UVA UVB Foundation - 40gm
description:
ISAAR Sunscreen Bronze Foundation SPF50+ PA+++ 40g | Made in China

Protect and enhance your skin with DISAAR Sunscreen Bronze Foundation SPF50+ PA+++. This lightweight, waterproof, and oil-free formula provides SPF 41-50 protection, suitable for all skin types, while giving your face a natural bronzed glow. Made with safe, organic ingredients, it combines sun protection with a subtle makeup finish.

Key Features:

SPF Protection: SPF50+ PA+++ for high sun defense

Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types

Formula: Waterproof, oil-free, and lightweight

Effect: Bronzing effect for a natural, radiant look

Weight: 40g

Origin: Made in China

Storage: Keep in a dry and cool place

Safe & Organic: Gentle on skin, ideal for daily use

Get sun protection and a flawless bronzed finish with DISAAR Sunscreen Bronze Foundation.
